## What

New skill `skills/sglang-explainer-video/`: send it an SGLang PR number (or a Markdown article path) and it produces a 1–3 min **Chinese explainer video** with word-synced **中文 / English captions**, the unified **SGLang cover**, and SGLang-brand visuals, delivered to `~/Desktop` together with a still cover PNG.

It drives HyperFrames' `pr-to-video` workflow (heygen-com/hyperframes, pinned at `d0b551d0`) and packages every fix needed to make it work for Chinese, so a fresh Claude session can reproduce the whole flow from `SKILL.md`.

## Pieces

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `SKILL.md` | Step-by-step flow for PR mode and article mode (ingest → brand → story/script → TTS → visual design → cover → captions → ≤3 frame workers → lint/check → render → frame-by-frame QA → Desktop) |
| `references/house-style.md` | User-confirmed rules: English technical terms (kernel, batch, mixed chunk…), Yunyang voice, bilingual captions, cover A spec, author page (name not spoken), never state PR status |
| `references/worker-dispatch.md` | Dispatch context for frame workers with the hard rules that broke earlier runs |
| `references/troubleshooting.md` | Every failure seen while building this, with the fix |
| `scripts/setup_env.sh` | Idempotent workspace: pinned HyperFrames + caption patch, venv (edge-tts, fonttools), Noto SC fonts, zsh-safe `hf` wrapper, `env.sh` |
| `scripts/edge_tts_engine.{py,mjs}` | `HF_MEDIA_ENGINE` replacement: edge-tts narration with per-word timings, punctuation re-attached, split terms re-joined (FP32, FLUX.2, torch.equal), closing pad, 403 workaround (rany2/edge-tts#491) |
| `patches/hyperframes-captions-cjk-bilingual.patch` | `captions.mjs`: clause-level CJK grouping, CJK-aware joining, optional `caption-translations.json` English line |
| `assets/caption-skin.html` | Caption skin: no inter-word gap for Chinese, English line under the karaoke line, bundled Noto fonts |
| `scripts/make_cover.py` | The fixed cover (design A, brand orange): video frame 1 (caption-safe, seek-safe) + still PNG |
| `scripts/apply_brand.py` | SGLang palette remixed onto the code-editorial preset, caption skin, logos |
| `scripts/subset_fonts.py` | Noto Sans/Serif SC subsets for every rendered glyph (no `local()` fonts — they garble in Studio) |
| `scripts/check_frames.mjs`, `retime_frames.py`, `qa_sheet.sh` | Frame-contract + font check, re-timing frames to a new narration take, contact sheets of the rendered MP4 |

Also: README skills table (+1, badge 10 → 11) and plugin/marketplace version 0.8.0 → 0.9.0.

## Validation

- `setup_env.sh` run from scratch on macOS (Node 22, ffmpeg, Chrome): ready in ~2 min; `hf --version` works under zsh.
- PR mode: sgl-project/sglang#43238 → 1:16 video (bilingual captions, author page, no status lines).
- Article mode: 《基于Agent的SGLang Diffusion Kernel优化实践》 → 3:00, 14 frames, 3 real figures; `hf lint` 0 errors, `hf check` passed (53/53 WCAG AA); frame-by-frame review of the rendered MP4 clean.
- Repo: `pre-commit` (black/isort/ruff/codespell/shebang) clean on the changed files, `pytest` 235 passed.

## Notes

- The PR-mode end-to-end run predates the final cover A design; the cover script itself was exercised in the article run.
- Videos and rendered MP4s are not committed (size); only two cover reference PNGs and the SGLang logos (from `sgl-project/sglang/assets`).

+---
+name: sglang-explainer-video
+description: Turn an SGLang PR (number or URL) or a technical article (Markdown path) into a 1–3 minute Chinese explainer video — natural edge-tts narration, word-synced bilingual 中文/English captions, the unified orange "SGLang PR 讲解 / SGLang 技术解读" cover, SGLang-brand visuals — built on HyperFrames' pr-to-video pipeline and delivered to ~/Desktop. Use when the user sends an sgl-project/sglang PR number or link, or an article file, and asks for a video (做个视频, 讲解视频, PR 视频, 文章转视频).
+---
+
+# SGLang explainer video
+
+Input: `sglang PR <N>` (or a github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/N URL), or a Markdown article path.
+Output: `~/Desktop/SGLang_PR<N>_讲解_中英字幕.mp4` (article: `SGLang_<slug>_技术解读_中英字幕.mp4`) plus a still `…_封面.png`, rendered 1920×1080 with a 中文 narration and bilingual captions.
+
+This skill drives HyperFrames' **pr-to-video** workflow (heygen-com/hyperframes, pinned) with a fixed house
+style and several fixes that make it work for Chinese. Read `references/house-style.md` before writing any
+script — it holds the rules the user already corrected once (terms, captions, cover, credits, PR status).
+
+## 0. Setup (start of every session)
+
+```bash
+bash <this-skill>/scripts/setup_env.sh      # first run ~2 min; afterwards seconds (idempotent)
+source ~/.cache/sglang-explainer-video/env.sh
+```
+
+Re-run it at the start of each session: `env.sh` records this skill's install path (`$SEV_SKILL`,
+`$HF_MEDIA_ENGINE`), so it must point at the copy you are using now.
+
+It needs Node ≥ 22 (`brew install node@22`), `ffmpeg`/`ffprobe`, git, curl and Chrome. It creates a venv
+(edge-tts, fonttools), a pinned HyperFrames checkout with `patches/hyperframes-captions-cjk-bilingual.patch`
+applied, the Noto Sans/Serif SC fonts, and `env.sh` (`$SKILL_DIR` = pr-to-video, `hf` = pinned HyperFrames CLI wrapper,
+`$HF_MEDIA_ENGINE` = our edge-tts engine, `$SEV_SKILL`, `$SEV_PY`). Nothing is installed globally:
+always run the CLI as `hf …`, never `npx hyperframes init` without the env (init would install skills
+into `~/.claude/skills`).
+
+Every command below assumes `source ~/.cache/sglang-explainer-video/env.sh` and `P=<project dir>`.
+
+## 1. Project + brief
+
+```bash
+P=$SEV_WS/projects/sglang-pr-<N>            # article: $SEV_WS/projects/sglang-article-<slug>
+hf init "$P" --non-interactive --example=blank --skill=pr-to-video
+```
+
+Write `$P/BRIEF.md` (template in `references/house-style.md` §Brief). Run **autonomous** (`flow: automation`,
+`storyboard: no`): do not stop for plan/sketch approval; the only questions worth asking are real choices
+(voice change, length) — otherwise follow the house style.
+
+## 2. Ingest the source
+
+PR mode — always the **full URL** (`owner/repo#N` fails outside a git checkout):
+
+```bash
+(cd $P && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/fetch-pr.mjs --pr https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/<N> --out-dir ./capture \
+  && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/ingest.mjs --pr-json ./capture/pr.json --diff ./capture/diff.patch --out-dir ./capture/extracted \
+  && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/fetch-people-avatars.mjs --people ./capture/extracted/people.json)
+```
+
+Article mode — copy the article to `$P/capture/extracted/visible-text.txt`, write a minimal
+`capture/extracted/tokens.json` (`{"title": "...", "colors": [], "fonts": []}`), and download the article's own
+figures into `$P/assets/article/fig<i>.<ext>` (they are the author's images; they become real assets on frames).
+
+Then put the SGLang brand on the project (frame.md remix, CJK/bilingual caption skin, logos):
+
+```bash
+$SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/apply_brand.py --project $P
+```
+
+## 3. Story + script
+
+Follow `$SKILL_DIR/SKILL.md` Step 3 and its `references/story-design.md` (PR: fix-explainer / feature-reveal /
+refactor-walkthrough; article: a value-first explainer — hook → landscape → method → 2–4 evidence beats →
+lessons → summary). Then apply the house style:
+
+- **Frame 1 is always the cover** `compositions/frames/00-cover.html` (built by `make_cover.py`, not a worker),
+  `status: animated`. Frame N's file is `NN-<slug>.html` with `NN = N-1`.
+- PR videos end on the **author page** (name/@login/avatar on screen, never spoken; the PR link; no status).
+- Chinese narration, English technical terms, ≲ 60 汉字 per frame (~11 s); whole film ≤ 3 min.
+- `SCRIPT.md` voice line: `zh-CN-YunyangNeural (edge-tts)`. Numbers only from the PR/article.
+
+## 4. Narration (edge-tts, word timings)
+
+```bash
+(cd $P && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/audio.mjs --script ./SCRIPT.md --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --hyperframes . \
+   --out ./audio_meta.json --voice zh-CN-YunyangNeural \
+ && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/audio.mjs sync-durations --audio-meta ./audio_meta.json --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md \
+ && cp audio_meta.json audio_meta.built.json)
+```
+
+`HF_MEDIA_ENGINE` swaps HyperFrames' TTS for `scripts/edge_tts_engine.py`: per-word timestamps from WordBoundary,
+punctuation re-attached, split terms re-joined (FP32, FLUX.2, torch.equal), 2 s of silence after the last line.
+Too long? Trim the script or `EDGE_TTS_RATE=+6%`. Print the timings for Step 5:
+
+```bash
+python3 -c "import json;[print(v['frame'],v['duration_s'],' | '.join(f\"{w['text']}@{w['start']}\" for w in v['words'])) for v in json.load(open('$P/audio_meta.json'))['voices']]"
+```
+
+**Keep `audio_meta.built.json`.** edge-tts takes are not bit-identical; frames are cued to this take.
+
+## 5. Visual design (Step 4 of pr-to-video)
+
+Write `## Video direction` + per-frame time-coded Scenes per `$SKILL_DIR/references/visual-design.md`, using the
+**real word start times** above. Put the palette/type/font rules from `references/house-style.md` §Visuals into
+Video direction. Code beats need a `### Source excerpt` (≤ 12 real lines); article frames that show a real figure
+carry `- asset_candidates: assets/article/figN.png — …`.
+
+## 6. Cover
+
+```bash
+$SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/make_cover.py --project $P --series "SGLang PR 讲解" --badge "#<N>" \
+  --title-zh "<一句中文问题/主张>" --title-en "<PR title>" --meta "<file> · +A / −D · @<author>" \
+  --duration <frame-1 voice s> --cue-title <s> --cue-meta <s> --png $P/cover.png
+```
+
+Article: `--series "SGLang 技术解读" --badge "<one keyword>"`. The design is fixed (see house style §Cover).
+
+## 7. Captions (bilingual)
+
+```bash
+(cd $P && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/captions.mjs build --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --audio-meta ./audio_meta.json \
+   --hyperframes . --out ./caption_groups.json)
+```
+
+Translate **every** group's `text` into `$P/caption-translations.json` (`{"<中文 group text>": "<English>"}`),
+then rebuild; the build warns `no translation for N group(s)` until all are covered.
+
+## 8. Frames (≤ 3 parallel workers)
+
+```bash
+(cd $P && for b in <code-* blocks named in STORYBOARD>; do hf add "$b"; done)
+node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/frame-packets.mjs --project "$P" --storyboard "$P/STORYBOARD.md"
+```
+
+Dispatch at most three background workers (Agent tool), each with the role file path, its packet paths and
+the dispatch context from `references/worker-dispatch.md` **verbatim** (it carries the hard rules that broke
+earlier runs). A packet over 48 KB means the blueprint + cited rules are too big: drop one cited rule or use
+`blueprint: compose`. Mark frames `animated` as workers return. Then:
+
+```bash
+node $SEV_SKILL/scripts/check_frames.mjs $P          # frame contract + no system CJK fonts
+$SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/subset_fonts.py --project $P   # re-run after ANY text change
+(cd $P && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/captions.mjs build --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --audio-meta ./audio_meta.json --hyperframes . --out ./caption_groups.json \
+ && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/assemble-index.mjs --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --hyperframes . \
+ && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/transitions.mjs inject --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --hyperframes . \
+ && node $SKILL_DIR/scripts/transitions.mjs verify --storyboard ./STORYBOARD.md --index ./index.html \
+ && hf lint && hf check)
+```
+
+A failed frame goes back to its worker once with the exact finding (SendMessage). `lint`/`check` errors you
+fix yourself with the smallest edit. `id_requires_css_escape` warnings and transition-time `content_overlap`
+infos are expected.
+
+## 9. Render, QA, deliver
+
+```bash
+(cd $P && hf render --skill=pr-to-video --quality high --output renders/video.mp4)
+bash $SEV_SKILL/scripts/qa_sheet.sh $P/renders/video.mp4 $P/qa 2.5
+```
+
+Read **every** sheet of the rendered MP4 (not Studio snapshots): 乱码, wrong characters, untranslated or
+mistranslated terms, captions out of sync, content under the caption band, stray status lines. Fix, re-render,
+re-check. Then copy to the Desktop:
+
+```bash
+cp $P/renders/video.mp4 ~/Desktop/SGLang_PR<N>_讲解_中英字幕.mp4
+cp $P/cover.png ~/Desktop/SGLang_PR<N>_讲解_封面.png
+```
+
+## Changing narration after frames exist
+
+Edit `SCRIPT.md` (and the storyboard `voiceover`), re-run Step 4, then — instead of rebuilding frames —
+
+```bash
+$SEV_PY -I $SEV_SKILL/scripts/retime_frames.py --project $P --ref-meta $P/audio_meta.built.json
+```
+
+re-maps each frame's timeline onto the new take (piecewise-linear, anchors = matched clause starts). Re-make
+the cover (`make_cover.py`) with the new frame-1 cues, retranslate changed caption groups, re-subset fonts,
+re-assemble, re-render.
+
+## References
+
+- `references/house-style.md` — narration, term glossary, captions, cover, author page, brief template.
+- `references/worker-dispatch.md` — the dispatch context to paste into every frame worker.
+- `references/troubleshooting.md` — every failure seen so far and its fix.

@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+# House style (user-confirmed — do not relitigate)
+
+Every rule here came from a correction on a delivered video. Apply all of them by default.
+
+## Narration
+
+- Language: Chinese narration, plain technical register (像给同事讲 PR), no hype.
+- **Technical nouns stay English** — never translate them:
+  kernel (never 内核), batch / mixed batch / mixed chunk (never 混批), prefill, decode, decode tail, prefix,
+  token, attention, metadata, output buffer, fallback, bit-exact, micro benchmark, profile, launch, step, CFG,
+  GEMM, quant, epilogue, branch, review, PR. Everyday words stay Chinese: 吞吐, 耗时, 并发, 端到端.
+- Write numbers as digits (15%, 3.79 ms); the TTS reads them correctly and captions show them verbatim.
+- Budget: ≲ 60 汉字 per frame (~11 s at Yunyang +0%), whole film ≤ 3 min. Measure after TTS and trim.
+- Numbers and claims only from the PR / article. Keep the source's own caveats when they matter
+  (e.g. "未在新 branch 上重测", "数据来自不同模型和硬件，不能相加").
+- **Never state PR status** — no "还在 review 中", "OPEN", "未合并", "in review" in narration or on screen.
+  PRs usually get merged; the video should not date itself.
+- Closing line for PR videos: `以上就是这个 PR 的全部改动。`
+
+## Voice
+
+- `zh-CN-YunyangNeural` (edge-tts, news-anchor male) at `+0%` — chosen by the user over Yunxi/Xiaoxiao/
+  Yunjian/Xiaoyi/Andrew/Ava after A/B samples. Only change it if the user asks.
+
+## Captions
+
+- Bilingual: Chinese karaoke line (word-synced highlight) + English line under it, every group translated.
+- Groups are clauses (split at ，。；：！？, max ~26 Han-width); never split after 、 or inside a term.
+- Translation: natural English for an engineer, same facts, keep the English terms as-is.
+
+## Cover (fixed: design "A · brand orange")
+
+`scripts/make_cover.py` renders it; never redesign it per video. Reference renders:
+`assets/brand/cover-example-pr.png` (PR) and `assets/brand/cover-example-article.png` (article).
+In the video frame the meta line and badge sit above the caption band and the text dissolves
+just before the crossfade; the still PNG keeps the full layout.
+
+- Full-bleed SGLang orange `#D55816`; SGL wordmark (`assets/brand/sglang-logo.png`) on a peach `#FADDCD`
+  card with a 5 px rust `#A5300F` border, top-left.
+- Series label, white, heavy: **`SGLang PR 讲解`** for PRs, **`SGLang 技术解读`** for articles; a peach
+  underline bar.
+- Bold white Chinese title (balanced wrap), peach EB Garamond italic English title, mono meta line.
+- The logo's node-graph motif (two nodes + `</>` box) oversized at right, peach, 22 % opacity.
+- Badge bottom-right in the logo-"L" style (peach fill, rust outline, trailing rust stripes): `#<PR number>`
+  for PRs, one short keyword for articles (e.g. `Diffusion`).
+- The cover is frame 1 of the video (with narration introducing the topic) and also exported as a still PNG.
+
+## Visuals (body frames)
+
+- frame.md = code-editorial remixed onto the SGLang brand by `apply_brand.py`: cream `#FBF6F1` ground,
+  peach cards `#F9E6DB` / `#F2CFBE`, ink `#1F1410`, accent SGLang orange `#D55816` at most once per frame,
+  warm near-black code surface.
+- Fonts: EB Garamond / Inter / JetBrains Mono + **bundled** Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC subsets only.
+  Never `local()`, PingFang, Songti, Hiragino — they garble in HyperFrames Studio.
+- Prefer real material: code hunks from the diff, the article's own figures (contain, never cropped).
+- Bottom ~17 % is the caption band.
+
+## Author page (PR videos)
+
+- Only the PR author (name + @login + avatar) and the PR link. No reviewers, approvers, commit counts or status.
+- The name is on screen only — the narration does not read it.
+
+## Delivery
+
+- Final MP4 and the still cover go straight to `~/Desktop`
+  (`SGLang_PR<N>_讲解_中英字幕.mp4`, `SGLang_PR<N>_讲解_封面.png`).
+- Before delivering, review contact sheets of the **rendered MP4** frame by frame.
+
+## Brief template (`BRIEF.md`)
+
+```markdown
+---
+workflow: pr-to-video
+flow: automation
+storyboard: no
+source: pr            # or: article
+pr: sgl-project/sglang#<N>
+series: SGLang PR 讲解  # article: SGLang 技术解读
+message: "<one sentence the viewer must take away>"
+destination: desktop
+aspect: 1920x1080
+language: zh
+audience: developers
+length: <40–70s for a focused PR, ≤ 180s for an article>
+angle: <fix-explainer | feature-reveal | refactor-walkthrough | changelog | article-explainer>
+narration: yes
+---
+
+## Intent
+<what the video explains, for whom>
+
+## Notes
+- House style: references/house-style.md (English terms, bilingual captions, Yunyang, cover A, no PR status).
+```

+# Troubleshooting (every failure seen while building this workflow)
+
+| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `npx hyperframes` errors / engines | HyperFrames CLI needs Node ≥ 22 | `brew install node@22`; `setup_env.sh` puts it first on PATH in `env.sh` |
+| `init` writes into `~/.claude/skills` | init refreshes global skills | `HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1` (set by `env.sh`); skills come from the pinned workspace checkout |
+| `fetch-pr: gh pr view "owner/repo#N" failed … not a git repository` | gh can't resolve `owner/repo#N` outside a checkout | pass the full PR URL |
+| edge-tts `WSServerHandshakeError: 403` | Oct 2026: legacy `speech.platform.bing.com` refuses synthesis | `edge_tts_engine.py` points `WSS_URL` at `api.msedgeservices.com` (rany2/edge-tts#491); `EDGE_TTS_LEGACY_HOST=1` to disable once upstream ships the fix |
+| Kokoro Chinese sounds robotic | HyperFrames' offline Kokoro phonemizes Chinese via espeak | use the edge-tts engine (`HF_MEDIA_ENGINE`) — default in `env.sh` |
+| 乱码 (random glyphs) in Studio, fine in snapshots | frames declared `@font-face{src:local("PingFang SC")}`; the .ttc picks the wrong face | bundle Noto SC subsets (`subset_fonts.py`); `check_frames.mjs` rejects `local()`/PingFang/Songti |

+"""edge-tts drop-in for the HyperFrames media audio engine (``HF_MEDIA_ENGINE``).
+
+Same CLI surface as ``media-use/audio/scripts/audio.mjs``::
+
+    --request audio_request.json --hyperframes DIR --out audio_engine_meta.json --only tts,bgm|sfx
+
+Writes the engine's neutral meta: ``voices[{id, path, duration_s, words[{id, text, start, end}]}]``.
+Word timings come from edge-tts WordBoundary events (no Whisper pass); the punctuation that
+follows each word in the script is re-attached so the caption grouper can split clauses.
+BGM / SFX are not provided: ``bgm`` stays null and ``sfx`` stays empty.
+
+Env:
+    EDGE_TTS_VOICE      default zh-CN-YunyangNeural (overridden by the request's ``voice``)
+    EDGE_TTS_RATE       default +0%
+    EDGE_TTS_PAD_LAST   seconds of silence appended to the LAST line (closing hold), default 2.0
+    EDGE_TTS_LEGACY_HOST=1  keep edge-tts' own synthesis host (skip the 403 workaround)
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import asyncio
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+
+import edge_tts
+import edge_tts.communicate as _comm
+from edge_tts.constants import TRUSTED_CLIENT_TOKEN
+
+if os.environ.get("EDGE_TTS_LEGACY_HOST") != "1":
+    # rany2/edge-tts#491: since Oct 2026 speech.platform.bing.com answers the synthesis
+    # WebSocket with 403; Edge 155 synthesizes through api.msedgeservices.com with the
+    # same token. Voice listing still uses the legacy host.
+    _comm.WSS_URL = (
+        "wss://api.msedgeservices.com/tts/cognitiveservices/websocket/v1"
+        f"?Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key={TRUSTED_CLIENT_TOKEN}"
+    )
+
+DEFAULT_VOICE = os.environ.get("EDGE_TTS_VOICE", "zh-CN-YunyangNeural")
+PUNCT = set("，。、；：！？,.;:!?…—）)」』”’")
+
+
+def _ascii(t):
+    return all(ord(c) < 128 for c in t)
+
+
+def merge_split_terms(text, words):
+    """Re-join Latin/number terms edge-tts splits apart: FP32 → FP|32, FLUX.2 → FLUX.|2,
+    torch.equal → torch.|equal, H100 → H|100. Two consecutive ASCII words merge when the
+    script has no whitespace between them; CJK words are never merged (karaoke granularity).
+    """
+    out, pos, prev_end = [], 0, None
+    for w in words:
+        idx = text.find(w["text"], pos)
+        if idx < 0:
+            out.append(dict(w))
+            prev_end = None
+            continue
+        end = idx + len(w["text"])
+        gap = text[prev_end:idx] if (prev_end is not None and idx >= prev_end) else None
+        if (
+            out
+            and gap is not None
+            and set(gap) <= set("._-/")
+            and _ascii(out[-1]["text"])
+            and _ascii(w["text"])
+        ):
+            out[-1]["text"] += gap + w["text"]
+            out[-1]["end"] = w["end"]
+        else:
+            out.append(dict(w))
+        pos = prev_end = end
+    return out
+
+
+def attach_punct(text, words):
+    """Append the punctuation that follows each word in ``text`` to that word."""
+    out, pos = [], 0
+    for w in words:
+        idx = text.find(w["text"], pos)
+        if idx < 0:
+            out.append(w)
+            continue
+        end = idx + len(w["text"])
+        tail = ""
+        while end < len(text) and (text[end] in PUNCT or text[end] == " "):
+            if text[end] != " ":
+                tail += text[end]
+            end += 1
+        out.append({**w, "text": w["text"] + tail})
+        pos = end
+    return out
+
+
+async def synth(text, voice, rate, mp3_path):
+    comm = edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice, rate=rate, boundary="WordBoundary")
+    words = []
+    with open(mp3_path, "wb") as f:
+        async for ch in comm.stream():
+            if ch["type"] == "audio":
+                f.write(ch["data"])
+            elif ch["type"] == "WordBoundary":
+                start = ch["offset"] / 1e7
+                words.append(
+                    {
+                        "text": ch["text"],
+                        "start": round(start, 3),
+                        "end": round(start + ch["duration"] / 1e7, 3),
+                    }
+                )
+    return words
+
+
+def duration(path):
+    r = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            "ffprobe",
+            "-v",
+            "error",
+            "-show_entries",
+            "format=duration",
+            "-of",
+            "csv=p=0",
+            path,
+        ],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=True,
+    )
+    return round(float(r.stdout.strip()), 3)
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--request", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--hyperframes", default=".")
+    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--only", default="tts,bgm")
+    args, _ = ap.parse_known_args()
+    only = set(args.only.split(","))
+    hf = os.path.abspath(args.hyperframes)
+
+    with open(args.request) as f:
+        request = json.load(f)
+    prev = {}
+    if os.path.exists(args.out):
+        with open(args.out) as f:
+            prev = json.load(f)
+    voice = request.get("voice") or DEFAULT_VOICE
+    rate = os.environ.get("EDGE_TTS_RATE", "+0%")
+    pad_last = float(os.environ.get("EDGE_TTS_PAD_LAST", "2.0"))
+
+    voices = prev.get("voices", [])
+    if "tts" in only:
+        voices = []
+        lines = [
+            ln for ln in request.get("lines", []) if str(ln.get("text", "")).strip()
+        ]
+        os.makedirs(os.path.join(hf, "assets", "voice"), exist_ok=True)
+        print(
+            f"· tts: edge-tts · voice {voice} · rate {rate} · {len(lines)} line(s)",
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+        for k, line in enumerate(lines):
+            text = str(line["text"]).strip()
+            lid = str(line["id"])
+            rel = f"assets/voice/{lid}.wav"
+            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+                mp3 = os.path.join(td, "line.mp3")
+                words = asyncio.run(synth(text, voice, rate, mp3))
+                af = (
+                    ["-af", f"apad=pad_dur={pad_last}"]
+                    if (k == len(lines) - 1 and pad_last > 0)
+                    else []
+                )
+                subprocess.run(
+                    [
+                        "ffmpeg",
+                        "-y",
+                        "-v",
+                        "error",
+                        "-i",
+                        mp3,
+                        *af,
+                        "-ar",
+                        "44100",
+                        "-ac",
+                        "1",
+                        os.path.join(hf, rel),
+                    ],
+                    check=True,
+                )
+            words = attach_punct(text, merge_split_terms(text, words))
+            dur = duration(os.path.join(hf, rel))
+            voices.append(
+                {
+                    "id": lid,
+                    "path": rel,
+                    "duration_s": dur,
+                    "words": [{"id": f"w{i}", **w} for i, w in enumerate(words)],
+                }
+            )
+            print(f"  voice {lid}: {rel} ({dur}s, {len(words)} words)", file=sys.stderr)
+
+    meta = {
+        "tts_provider": "edge-tts" if "tts" in only else prev.get("tts_provider"),
+        "voice_id": voice if "tts" in only else prev.get("voice_id"),
+        "bgm": None if "bgm" in only else prev.get("bgm"),
+        "bgm_pending": False,
+        "voices": voices,
+        "sfx": [] if "sfx" in only else prev.get("sfx", []),
+        "total_duration_s": round(sum(v["duration_s"] for v in voices), 3),
+    }
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
+    with open(args.out, "w") as f:
+        json.dump(meta, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+    print(
+        f"✓ edge-tts engine → {args.out} · voices: {len(voices)} · total {meta['total_duration_s']}s"
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Re-time already-built frames to a new narration take without rebuilding them.
+
+Use when only the voice changed (new voice, reworded line, a fresh edge-tts take — takes are
+not bit-identical, so word timings drift by a few hundred ms). Each frame's timeline stays cued
+to the take it was built against; this wraps it in an outer timeline driven through a
+piecewise-linear map whose anchors are clause starts matched across the two takes.
+
+    python retime_frames.py --project DIR --ref-meta audio_meta.built.json [--frames 02-hook=2 ...]
+
+``--ref-meta`` is a copy of audio_meta.json from when the frames were built (keep one!).
+``--frames`` maps frame file id → storyboard frame number; default: every frames/NN-*.html
+whose leading NN+1 equals its storyboard frame (cover = 00 → frame 1).
+Re-running is safe: an existing WARP array is replaced.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import difflib
+import glob
+import json
+import os
+import re
+
+PUNCT_END = re.compile(r"[，。；：！？、,.;:!?]$")
+
+
+def norm(t):
+    return re.sub(r"[，。；：！？、,.;:!?%]", "", t)
+
+
+def anchors(old, new):
+    ow, nw = old["words"], new["words"]
+    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(
+        None,
+        [norm(w["text"]) for w in ow],
+        [norm(w["text"]) for w in nw],
+        autojunk=False,
+    )
+    match = {}
+    for b in sm.get_matching_blocks():
+        for k in range(b.size):
+            match[b.a + k] = b.b + k
+    pairs = [(0.0, 0.0)]
+    for i in [0] + [
+        i + 1 for i, w in enumerate(ow[:-1]) if PUNCT_END.search(w["text"])
+    ]:
+        j = i
+        while (
+            j < len(ow)
+            and j not in match
+            and not (j > i and PUNCT_END.search(ow[j - 1]["text"]))
+        ):
+            j += 1
+        if j in match:
+            n_t, o_t = nw[match[j]]["start"], ow[j]["start"]
+            if n_t > pairs[-1][0] + 0.2 and o_t > pairs[-1][1] + 0.2:
+                pairs.append((n_t, o_t))
+    on, nn = old["duration_s"], new["duration_s"]
+    pairs += [(nn, on), (nn + 0.5, on + 0.5)]
+    return [[round(a, 3), round(b, 3)] for a, b in pairs], nn
+
+
+WRAP = """
+{ind}// Re-timed to a newer narration take: the timeline above is cued to the take it was built
+{ind}// against; WARP maps [voiceTime, cueTime] (anchors = clause starts matched across takes).
+{ind}var WARP = {warp};
+{ind}var warpEnd = WARP[WARP.length - 1];
+{ind}var warpEase = function (p) {{
+{ind}  var t = p * warpEnd[0];
+{ind}  for (var k = 1; k < WARP.length; k++) {{
+{ind}    if (t <= WARP[k][0]) {{
+{ind}      var a = WARP[k - 1], b = WARP[k];
+{ind}      return (a[1] + ((t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])) * (b[1] - a[1])) / warpEnd[1];
+{ind}    }}
+{ind}  }}
+{ind}  return 1;
+{ind}}};
+{ind}var outer = gsap.timeline({{ paused: true }});
+{ind}outer.add(tl.tweenFromTo(0, warpEnd[1], {{ duration: warpEnd[0], ease: warpEase }}), 0);
+{ind}window.__timelines[{key}] = outer;"""
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--project", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--ref-meta", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--frames", nargs="*", default=[])
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    proj = os.path.abspath(a.project)
+    with open(a.ref_meta) as f:
+        ref = {v["frame"]: v for v in json.load(f)["voices"]}
+    with open(os.path.join(proj, "audio_meta.json")) as f:
+        cur = {v["frame"]: v for v in json.load(f)["voices"]}
+    mapping = dict(kv.split("=") for kv in a.frames)
+    if not mapping:
+        for p in sorted(
+            glob.glob(os.path.join(proj, "compositions", "frames", "[0-9][0-9]-*.html"))
+        ):
+            fid = os.path.basename(p)[:-5]
+            mapping[fid] = str(int(fid[:2]) + 1)
+    for fid, n in mapping.items():
+        n = int(n)
+        if n not in ref or n not in cur:
+            continue
+        warp, nn = anchors(ref[n], cur[n])
+        p = os.path.join(proj, "compositions", "frames", f"{fid}.html")
+        with open(p) as f:
+            s = f.read()
+        if "var WARP = " in s:
+            s = re.sub(
+                r"var WARP = \[\[.*?\]\];",
+                "var WARP = " + json.dumps(warp) + ";",
+                s,
+                count=1,
+            )
+        else:
+            m = re.search(r"\n([ \t]*)window\.__timelines\[([^\]]+)\] = tl;", s)
+            if not m:
+                print(f"skip {fid}: no `window.__timelines[...] = tl;` registration")
+                continue
+            s = (
+                s[: m.start()]
+                + WRAP.format(ind=m.group(1), warp=json.dumps(warp), key=m.group(2))
+                + s[m.end() :]
+            )
+        s = re.sub(
+            r'data-duration="[\d.]+"', f'data-duration="{round(nn + 0.5, 3)}"', s
+        )
+        with open(p, "w") as f:
+            f.write(s)
+        print(f"✓ {fid}: {ref[n]['duration_s']}s → {nn}s, {len(warp)} anchors")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Prepare (idempotently) everything sglang-explainer-video needs, then print the env file to source.
+#
+#   bash setup_env.sh            # workspace defaults to ~/.cache/sglang-explainer-video
+#   SGLANG_VIDEO_HOME=/path bash setup_env.sh
+#
+# Installs nothing globally: a Python venv, a pinned HyperFrames checkout (skills + scripts),
+# and the Noto SC fonts all live in the workspace. Needs Node >= 22, ffmpeg/ffprobe, git, curl,
+# and a Chrome/Chromium for the still cover PNG.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+SKILL_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
+WS="${SGLANG_VIDEO_HOME:-$HOME/.cache/sglang-explainer-video}"
+HF_COMMIT="${HF_COMMIT:-d0b551d0330d4d2cd932348a911b5457ed1ed3c8}" # heygen-com/hyperframes, 2026-10-12
+HF_CLI_VERSION="${HF_CLI_VERSION:-0.8.149}"
+mkdir -p "$WS"
+
+# 1. Node >= 22 (HyperFrames CLI engines field). A keg-only Homebrew node@22 is fine.
+NODE_BIN=""
+for c in "$(command -v node || true)" /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node /usr/local/opt/node@22/bin/node; do
+  if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ] && [ "$("$c" -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]')" -ge 22 ]; then
+    NODE_BIN="$(dirname "$c")"
+    break
+  fi
+done
+if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ]; then
+  echo "✗ Node >= 22 not found. macOS: brew install node@22 (keg-only; your default node is untouched)." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+# 2. ffmpeg + ffprobe (HyperFrames render/audio, QA contact sheets).
+if ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null || ! command -v ffprobe >/dev/null; then
+  echo "✗ ffmpeg/ffprobe not found. macOS: brew install ffmpeg" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+# 3. Chrome/Chromium for the still cover PNG.
+CHROME_BIN="${CHROME:-}"
+if [ -z "$CHROME_BIN" ]; then
+  for c in "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" \
+    "$(command -v google-chrome || true)" "$(command -v chromium || true)" "$(command -v chromium-browser || true)"; do
+    if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then CHROME_BIN="$c"; break; fi
+  done
+fi
+[ -n "$CHROME_BIN" ] || echo "⚠ no Chrome/Chromium found — set CHROME=... before make_cover.py renders cover.png" >&2
+
+# 4. Python venv: edge-tts (narration + word boundaries), fonttools (CJK subsetting), pillow.
+PY="${PYTHON:-python3}"
+[ -x "$WS/venv/bin/python" ] || "$PY" -m venv "$WS/venv"
+"$WS/venv/bin/pip" install -q "edge-tts>=7.2" fonttools brotli pillow
+
+# 5. HyperFrames (pinned) — the pr-to-video skill + scripts this workflow drives — plus our CJK/bilingual
+#    caption patch. Cloned into the workspace instead of `npx hyperframes skills` so nothing global changes.
+if [ ! -d "$WS/hyperframes/.git" ]; then
+  git clone -q --filter=blob:none https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.git "$WS/hyperframes"
+fi
+git -C "$WS/hyperframes" fetch -q origin "$HF_COMMIT" 2>/dev/null || true
+git -C "$WS/hyperframes" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout -q "$HF_COMMIT"
+PATCH="$SKILL_ROOT/patches/hyperframes-captions-cjk-bilingual.patch"
+if git -C "$WS/hyperframes" apply --check "$PATCH" 2>/dev/null; then
+  git -C "$WS/hyperframes" apply "$PATCH"
+  echo "· applied $(basename "$PATCH")"
+fi
+
+# 6. Noto Sans/Serif SC (OFL, google/fonts). Never use local("PingFang SC") etc.: the .ttc picks the
+#    wrong face in HyperFrames Studio and renders random glyphs (乱码). subset_fonts.py ships subsets.
+mkdir -p "$WS/fonts"
+for pair in "notosanssc/NotoSansSC%5Bwght%5D.ttf:NotoSansSC.ttf" "notoserifsc/NotoSerifSC%5Bwght%5D.ttf:NotoSerifSC.ttf"; do
+  src="${pair%%:*}"
+  dst="${pair##*:}"
+  [ -s "$WS/fonts/$dst" ] || curl -fsSL -o "$WS/fonts/$dst" "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/$src"
+done
+
+# 7. `hf` wrapper for the pinned CLI (a plain $HF variable does not word-split in zsh).
+mkdir -p "$WS/bin"
+printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec npx -y hyperframes@%s "$@"\n' "$HF_CLI_VERSION" >"$WS/bin/hf"
+chmod +x "$WS/bin/hf"
+
+# 8. Env file every later command sources.
+cat >"$WS/env.sh" <<EOF
+export PATH="$WS/bin:$NODE_BIN:\$PATH"
+export HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1
+export SEV_SKILL="$SKILL_ROOT"
+export SEV_WS="$WS"
+export SKILL_DIR="$WS/hyperframes/skills/pr-to-video"
+export MEDIA_DIR="$WS/hyperframes/skills/media-use"
+export HF_MEDIA_ENGINE="$SKILL_ROOT/scripts/edge_tts_engine.mjs"
+export EDGE_ENGINE_PYTHON="$WS/venv/bin/python"
+export SEV_PY="$WS/venv/bin/python"
+export CHROME="$CHROME_BIN"
+EOF
+PATH="$NODE_BIN:$PATH" npx -y "hyperframes@$HF_CLI_VERSION" --version >/dev/null
+echo "✓ ready — run: source $WS/env.sh"

+"""Ship Noto Sans/Serif SC subsets that cover every character the project renders.
+
+    python subset_fonts.py --project DIR [--fonts-dir $SEV_WS/fonts]
+
+Scans compositions/**/*.html, caption_groups.json, caption-translations.json, SCRIPT.md and
+STORYBOARD.md, subsets the variable OFL fonts to woff2 in assets/fonts/, and fails if any CJK
+character the frames use is still missing. Re-run after any text change (new narration,
+captions or on-screen labels) — a missing glyph silently falls back to a system face.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import glob
+import os
+import string
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+
+from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
+
+EXTRA = "，。、；：！？（）《》「」“”‘’…—·×≈→←↑↓①②③④⑤⑥✱✓¼½ "
+FONTS = (
+    ("NotoSansSC.ttf", "NotoSansSC-Subset.woff2"),
+    ("NotoSerifSC.ttf", "NotoSerifSC-Subset.woff2"),
+)
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--project", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument(
+        "--fonts-dir",
+        default=os.path.join(
+            os.environ.get(
+                "SEV_WS", os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/sglang-explainer-video")
+            ),
+            "fonts",
+        ),
+    )
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    proj = os.path.abspath(a.project)
+    sources = glob.glob(
+        os.path.join(proj, "compositions", "**", "*.html"), recursive=True
+    )
+    sources += [
+        os.path.join(proj, n)
+        for n in (
+            "caption_groups.json",
+            "caption-translations.json",
+            "SCRIPT.md",
+            "STORYBOARD.md",
+        )
+        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(proj, n))
+    ]
+    chars = set(string.printable) | set(EXTRA)
+    for p in sources:
+        with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            chars |= set(f.read())
+    chars = {c for c in chars if c.isprintable() and c not in "\r\n\t"}
+    out_dir = os.path.join(proj, "assets", "fonts")
+    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
+        "w", suffix=".txt", delete=False, encoding="utf-8"
+    ) as t:
+        t.write("".join(sorted(chars)))
+        text_file = t.name
+    used_cjk = set()
+    for p in glob.glob(
+        os.path.join(proj, "compositions", "**", "*.html"), recursive=True
+    ):
+        with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            used_cjk |= {c for c in f.read() if ord(c) > 0x2E80}
+    ok = True
+    for src, dst in FONTS:
+        out = os.path.join(out_dir, dst)
+        subprocess.run(
+            [
+                sys.executable,
+                "-m",
+                "fontTools.subset",
+                os.path.join(a.fonts_dir, src),
+                f"--text-file={text_file}",
+                "--flavor=woff2",
+                "--layout-features=*",
+                f"--output-file={out}",
+            ],
+            check=True,
+        )
+        cmap = TTFont(out).getBestCmap()
+        missing = "".join(sorted(c for c in used_cjk if ord(c) not in cmap))
+        print(
+            f"✓ {dst}: {os.path.getsize(out) // 1024} KB · missing CJK: {missing or 'none'}"
+        )
+        ok &= not missing
+    os.unlink(text_file)
+    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
